quote: A function's kind is decided by a keyword on the function, never by its body or by a type.
before:
import * as Effectable from "effect/Effectable"

export const effectClass: any = ((impl?: any) =>
  impl === undefined
    ? (innerImpl: any) => effectClass(innerImpl)
    : (Object.assign(class {}, Effectable.Prototype({ label: "alchemy/EffectClass", evaluate: () => impl })) as any)) as any
